mapper.select: select reservation_id, user_id, room_id, seat_id, start_time, end_time, check_deadline, status from seatflow_reservation where reservation_id = #{reservationId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into seatflow_checkin_record (reservation_id, user_id, checkin_time, status, create_time) values (#{reservationId}, #{userId}, #{now}, 'active', #{now})
mapper.select: select reservation_id, user_id, room_id, seat_id, start_time, end_time, check_deadline, status from seatflow_reservation where status = 'pending_checkin' and check_deadline < #{now} order by check_deadline asc, reservation_id asc limit #{limit} for update skip locked
mapper.insert: insert into seatflow_violation_record (reservation_id, user_id, reason, violation_time, status, create_time) values (#{reservationId}, #{userId}, #{reason}, #{now}, 'active', #{now})
mapper.select: select violation_count from seatflow_user_profile where user_id = #{userId} for update
mapper.update: update seatflow_user_profile set blacklist_flag = 'yes', update_time = current_timestamp where user_id = #{userId} and blacklist_flag <> 'yes'
mapper.insert: insert into seatflow_blacklist (user_id, violation_id, reason, start_time, end_time, status, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{violationId}, #{reason}, #{now}, null, 'active', #{now}) on duplicate key update violation_id = values(violation_id), reason = values(reason), start_time = least(start_time, values(start_time)), end_time = null, status = 'active', update_time = values(start_time)
mapper.select:
select v.violation_id, v.reservation_id, v.user_id, u.user_name, p.student_no, v.reason, v.violation_time, v.status from seatflow_violation_record v inner join sys_user u on u.user_id = v.user_id left join seatflow_user_profile p on p.user_id = v.user_id
and v.user_id = #{userId}
and u.user_name like concat('%', #{query.userName}, '%')
and p.student_no like concat('%', #{query.studentNo}, '%')
order by v.violation_time desc, v.violation_id desc

select b.blacklist_id, b.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, p.student_no, p.violation_count, b.reason, b.start_time, b.end_time, b.status from seatflow_blacklist b inner join sys_user u on u.user_id = b.user_id inner join seatflow_user_profile p on p.user_id = b.user_id where b.status = 'active'
and u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')
and p.student_no like concat('%', #{studentNo}, '%')
order by b.start_time desc, b.blacklist_id desc
